note: Generated 2026-11-20 by `python -m analysis.reference_1_0 --generate` after every chain matched its saved cache record field for field (timing and the engine stamp excluded; runs/reference_1_0_generate.log). `used` names the variant cells that built each chain's configs at generation, the first variant with an identical config (e.g. the licensing never chains through liability's cells); later checks prefer the run's own variant. The configs are identical (canonical JSON), so the digests do not depend on which variant built them.
